name: jev
description: Skills that teach Codex to drive the jev CLI: single judgments, CI gates and streamed batches.

interface.shortDescription: Correct jev invocations for judgments, gates and batches
interface.longDescription: Teach Codex to drive the jev CLI: ask for a probability, a pick or a rating on one piece of text, gate a CI step on a judgment, and stream a file of records through jev.
defaultPrompt: Use jev to judge this text.
Gate this CI step on a jev judgment.
Run this file of records through jev.
